answer_3.quote: PlausiFyer offers a user-friendly summary and explanation of the latent concept and its relationship to the input instance using a Large Language Model (LLM).
methods: prompting LLM to elucidate relation between input sentence and latent concept
criteria: common semantic, structural, lexical and topical relation

answer_4.quote: We conduct a human evaluation using four annotators across 50 test samples.
answer_4.guideline: Given an explanation, annotators are asked to answer five questions (Q1-Q5) that aimed at evaluating the usefulness of LACOAT.
